name: Get easy quotes for WP Development project
author: wpspin

sections.description:
🚀 Get Easy Quotes for WP Development Project is the simplest way to request accurate development quotes right from your WordPress dashboard. Whether you need a custom plugin, a brand-new theme, help fixing an error, or just have a general WordPress question — this plugin packages your requirements into a clean, structured format that any developer can understand instantly.

🎯 Stop wasting time on back-and-forth emails. Fill out one smart form, and let the plugin do the rest.

🔧 How It Works

  1. 📋 Smart Project Form – Choose your project type and fill out a simple form. The fields adapt automatically based on what you need — plugin development, theme design, error troubleshooting, or a general question.
  2. 🖥️ Built-in Screen Recording – Record your screen directly in the browser to demonstrate bugs, show design references, or walk through your requirements visually. No extra software needed.
  3. 📸 Screenshot Uploads – Attach screenshots to give developers a clear picture of the issue or desired outcome.
  4. ⚙️ Auto-Detected System Info – The plugin automatically captures your active plugins, current theme, browser details, IP address, and timezone — the exact details developers need to help you faster.
  5. 📄 Structured File Generation – Your requirements are organized into a downloadable file (JSON or human-readable TXT) that you can share with any developer.
  6. ⚡ Instant Quote via Email – With one click, send your project details directly to the WPspins team at estimates@wpspins.com for a fast, accurate estimate.
  7. 🔒 Full Data Transparency – Before anything is shared, you see exactly what data will be sent and must give explicit consent. You stay in control.
  8. 📂 Project History – Every submission is saved in your dashboard as a project record so you can revisit, compare, or re-share any time.

⭐ Key Features

  • 📝 Adaptive form with conditional fields per project type
  • 🎬 In-browser screen recording (WebM) — no third-party tools
  • 📸 Screenshot upload support
  • 🔍 Automatic environment detection (plugins, theme, browser, IP, timezone)
  • 📁 Download requirements as JSON or TXT
  • 📧 One-click email submission to WPspins for instant quotes
  • ✅ Data consent prompt before sharing any information
  • 🗂️ Custom post type to store and manage all project submissions
  • 🌐 Translation-ready with full internationalization support
  • 🛡️ Secure — nonce verification, input sanitization, and capability checks

💡 10+ Real-World Use Cases

  1. 🔌 Request a Custom Plugin Quote – Need a booking system, membership plugin, or custom integration? Describe your requirements, attach references, and get an accurate estimate from a developer.
  2. 🎨 Get a Theme Development Estimate – Share your mockup links, design references, and feature wishlist to get a quote for a fully custom WordPress theme.
  3. 🐛 Troubleshoot a WordPress Error – Record the error on screen, describe what happened, and let the plugin auto-detect your environment so a developer can diagnose the issue quickly.
  4. ❓ Ask a General WordPress Question – Not sure if something is possible? Submit your question along with a screen recording or screenshot for context.
  5. 🏢 Agency Client Intake – Agencies can use the plugin to collect structured requirements from clients before scoping a project, saving hours of discovery calls.
  6. 🔄 Compare Quotes from Multiple Developers – Download the structured requirements file and send it to several developers to compare their estimates side by side.
  7. 📚 Build a Project History – Keep a log of all your development requests in one place. Revisit past projects to track what was quoted, built, or still pending.
  8. 🛠️ Report Plugin Conflicts – When a plugin update breaks your site, record the error, let the plugin capture your active plugin list, and send the full report to a developer.
  9. 🖌️ Request Theme Customizations – Already have a theme but need tweaks? Describe the changes, attach screenshots of what you want modified, and get a quote.
  10. 🌍 Multilingual Team Collaboration – The plugin is fully translation-ready, so teams working in different languages can use it comfortably.
  11. 📊 Pre-Sales Scoping for Freelancers – Freelance developers can install this on client sites to collect detailed requirements before providing an estimate.
  12. 🚨 Emergency Bug Reports – Quickly capture everything a developer needs (screen recording, error details, environment info) and send it off in under a minute.

📖 Setup & Usage Instructions

Step 1: Install the Plugin 📥
– Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
– Search for “Get easy quotes for WP Development project” and click Install Now, then Activate.
– Or upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.

Step 2: Open the Calculator 🧮
– After activation, look for “WP-Dev Cost Calculator” in the left-hand admin menu (with a calculator icon).
– Click it to open the project quote form.

Step 3: Choose Your Project Type 🎯
– Select one of the four options:
– 🔌 Plugin Development
– 🎨 Theme Development
– 🐛 WP Error Troubleshooting
– ❓ General WP Question
– The form fields will automatically adjust based on your selection.

Step 4: Fill Out the Form ✍️
– Enter the required details. Depending on your project type, you may see fields for:
– Site URL, plugin/theme details, reference links
– Error descriptions, mockup links
– Screen recording and screenshot upload options
– Your active plugins, theme, browser info, and timezone are captured automatically — no need to type them manually.

Step 5: Record Your Screen (Optional) 🎬
– Click “Record Screen” to capture a video of your issue or requirements.
– Click “Stop Recording” when done. The video is uploaded and attached to your submission automatically.

Step 6: Submit Your Project ✅
– Click Submit. Your project is saved to the dashboard and a success modal appears with next steps.

Step 7: Download or Share 📤
– 📄 Download File – Get your requirements as a JSON or TXT file to share with any developer.
– 📧 Share with WPspins – Check the data consent box, review what will be sent, and click Share to email your project to estimates@wpspins.com for an instant quote.

Step 8: View Past Projects 🗂️
– Go to WP-Dev Cost Calculator → All Projects to see all your submitted projects.
– Click any project to view its full details.

🤝 Works Great With These Popular Plugins

This plugin integrates seamlessly into any WordPress setup. Here are some popular plugins it pairs well with:

  • 📧 WP Mail SMTP – Improve email deliverability when sending project quotes via email. WP Mail SMTP ensures your quote emails reach the inbox by routing them through a proper SMTP provider (Gmail, SendGrid, Mailgun, etc.).
  • 🛡️ Wordfence Security – Keep your site secure while collecting project data. Wordfence protects your admin area and ensures form submissions are safe from brute-force attacks and malicious activity.
  • 🚀 WP Rocket – Speed up your WordPress admin dashboard for a smoother form experience. WP Rocket’s caching and optimization features keep everything fast, even on resource-heavy sites.
  • 📊 MonsterInsights (Google Analytics) – Track how often the calculator page is visited and how many projects are submitted. Useful for agencies measuring client engagement.
  • 🔐 Two Factor Authentication – Add an extra layer of security to your admin area where project data is stored. Protects sensitive project details from unauthorized access.
  • 🌐 WPML / Polylang – Translate the plugin interface into any language. Since the plugin is fully internationalization-ready, WPML or Polylang can be used to serve multilingual teams.
  • 📁 FileBird (Media Library Folders) – Organize uploaded screen recordings and screenshots into neat folders within your WordPress media library.
  • 🔄 UpdraftPlus – Back up your project submissions along with the rest of your site. Ensures you never lose your project history.
  • 📝 WPForms / Gravity Forms – While this plugin handles quote requests, you can use WPForms or Gravity Forms for other site forms, keeping a consistent form management experience across your site.
  • 🧹 WP-Optimize – Keep your database clean and performant, especially if you accumulate many project submissions over time.

License

sections.installation:
📥 Automatic Installation (Recommended)
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
2. Search for “Get easy quotes for WP Development project”.
3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

📂 Manual Installation
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now, then Activate.

🔧 Manual Upload via FTP
1. Extract the ZIP file on your computer.
2. Upload the get-easy-quotes-for-wp-development-project folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
3. Go to Plugins in your WordPress admin and click Activate next to the plugin.

🎉 Once activated, find “WP-Dev Cost Calculator” in the admin sidebar menu to get started!
sections.faq:
🔍 Where can I find my submitted projects?

Go to WP-Dev Cost Calculator → All Projects in the WordPress admin dashboard. All your submissions are stored there as individual project records.

🔒 How is my data handled?

Your data stays on your site until you choose to share it. You can download it as a file (JSON or TXT) to share manually, or send it via email to estimates@wpspins.com. Before emailing, the plugin shows you exactly what data will be sent and requires your explicit consent.

📧 Can I send my requirements to a developer other than WPspins?

Yes! Use the Download File option to get a structured requirements file (JSON or TXT format). You can then share this file with any developer or agency of your choice.

🎬 How does the screen recording work?

The plugin uses your browser’s built-in screen capture API. Click “Record Screen”, select the screen or window to share, and click “Stop Recording” when done. The video is saved as a WebM file and attached to your project — no extra software needed.

🔌 Does this plugin work with my theme and other plugins?

Yes. The plugin is lightweight and runs entirely within the WordPress admin area. It does not modify your frontend, add scripts to your public pages, or conflict with themes or other plugins.

🌐 Is the plugin available in other languages?

The plugin is fully translation-ready. It uses WordPress internationalization standards and includes a .pot file for translators. You can translate it using WPML, Polylang, Loco Translate, or any translation tool.

🛡️ Is it secure?

Yes. The plugin uses WordPress nonce verification on all form submissions, sanitizes all input data, escapes all output, and restricts access to users with the manage_options capability (administrators only).

⚙️ Are there any settings to configure?

No configuration is needed. The plugin works out of the box. Simply activate it and start using the calculator form from the admin menu.
